topPRs.title: release: promote production database authority pin
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
Promotes the exact resolver repair from develop to main after staging certification run 33029204602 completes.

## Scope
- production Railway database authority resolver accepts the explicitly pinned digest-immutable Postgres service
- unpinned discovery remains fail-closed and restricted to one tagged PostgreSQL 18 service
- dual authority audit requires PostgreSQL 18

## Identity
- develop `4464bbef7a1f8dc00e5d577b6d47df4e0b7d504f`
- tree `314f802e9b478bf9881c72195bfc44174c746f62`
- current main `c0a8de04019f62a96c5f6bf21ee7c15ee554cafe`

## Gates
- PR #29439 merged after 13/13 focused tests, Cloud shared typecheck, Biome, diff-check, hosted source static smoke, and a live read-only Railway pin match
- live dual-authority production audit now passes with exact authority/schema/current-ledger verdicts
- staging certification run 33029204602 is intentionally pending and this PR must not merge until it succeeds

No Dedicated selection/adoption/job/compute/cutover/deletion/funding/billing mutation is contained in this promotion.
